label: Cisco UCS C240 M7 2U rack server
description: 2U two-socket rack server whose base server ships with a single dedicated 1Gbase-T RJ-45 management port for the CIMC; the one modular mLOM/OCP 3.0 slot (x16) and up to 8 PCIe 4.0 or 4 PCIe 5.0 slots are free for 10/25/50/100/200G VIC or OCP adapters.
